title: Gaslighting Your Fans w/ Dolby ATMOS™
summary: Musician and audio engineer Benn Jordan tries Dolby Atmos as a consumer, covering the theory of immersive audio, its business model, and home theater and headphone listening. He concludes it often falls short of the pitch.
why: HN points to it in Atmos and spatial audio threads as a knowledgeable critique of why the format rarely delivers.

quote.text: I found this video by Benn Jordan very enlightening about the whole Atmos nonsense
